The '''''Kintan Comet''''' was a starship that [[Fensi Moisk]] served as a crew member aboard in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="AOTC Guide">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Ultimate Illustrated Guide]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Kintan Comet'' was first mentioned in the [[2013]] [[Star Wars Visual Dictionaries|visual guide]], ''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Ultimate Illustrated Guide]]'', which was written by [[Jason Fry]]. The book was originally written in English and slated to be published, but only found a Danish release as ''Star Wars: Klonernes Angreb Den Ultimative Illustrerede Guide''. Jason Fry confirmed on Bluesky that the Danish caption "Kintansk Comet-mandskabsuniform" beside [[Fensi Moisk]]'s picture was originally written in English as "Kintan Comet crewer's uniform" where Kintan Comet would have been the name of a starship.<ref name="Bluesky">{{Bluesky|jasoncfry.bsky.social|post/3lpikz2qlwc2x|[[Jason Fry]]|date=2025-05-18|quote=Found it! "Kintan Comet crewer's uniform" where Kintan Comet would have been a starship.|archiveurl=https://ghostarchive.org/archive/XhhN3}}</ref>
